sit: the child sits down on the mat and settles comfortably, hands on knees
sleep: the child sleeps peacefully on the mat, chest rising and falling, a small shift of the head
walk: the child walks forward across the compound at an easy pace, arms swinging
jump: the child jumps up with both feet, arms rising, and lands with a happy bounce
stand: the child stands up straight, shifts weight slightly and looks ahead
cry: the child cries, rubbing tears from the eyes with the back of the hand
laugh: the child laughs out loud, head tipping back, shoulders shaking with joy
sing: the child sings, mouth opening and closing with the song, one hand keeping time
dance: the child dances, stepping side to side and clapping to a beat
read: the child reads the book, eyes moving along the lines and a page turning
write: the child writes on the paper with the pencil, hand moving slowly along the line
draw: the child draws a picture with the crayon, hand moving in small strokes
cook: the woman stirs the pot over the fire with a long spoon, steam rising
sweep: the child sweeps the ground with the short broom, bending and sweeping side to side, a little dust rising
pray: the boy prays on the mat, bowing forward slowly and rising again
climb: the child climbs the tree, reaching up hand over hand
swim: the child swims in the river, arms stroking through the water, small splashes
clap: the child claps both hands together in a steady happy rhythm
talk: the child talks, mouth moving and hands gesturing gently
listen: the child listens carefully, hand cupped behind the ear, head tilting slightly
look: the child looks into the distance, shading the eyes with a hand and turning the head slowly
open: the child opens the door, pulling it slowly towards them
close: the child closes the door, pushing it gently until it shuts
give: the child holds out the object with both hands and gives it to the other person
carry: the child carries the bucket on the head, walking steadily forward
push: the child pushes the cart forward, leaning into it
pull: the child pulls the rope with both hands, leaning back
kick: the child swings a leg and kicks the ball, which rolls away
throw: the child throws the ball forward with one arm
catch: the child catches the ball with both hands and holds it
ride: the child rides the bicycle forward, pedalling, wheels turning
drive: the man drives the car, turning the steering wheel slightly, looking ahead
wake: the child wakes up, stretching both arms and rubbing the eyes
bathe: the child bathes, pouring water from a small bowl over the shoulders
brush_teeth: the child brushes teeth with the toothbrush, hand moving side to side
comb: the child combs the hair with the comb, hand moving in slow strokes
dress: the child pulls on the shirt, arms going through the sleeves
farm_work: the farmer swings the hoe into the soil, bending and lifting it again
fetch_water: the girl draws water at the well, pulling the rope up hand over hand
sell: the trader hands goods across the table and takes the money, nodding
buy: the child hands over money and receives the item, looking pleased
help: the child helps lift the basket together with the other person, both smiling
